question: An item is marked for Rs. 18,000. A shopkeeper gives two successive discounts of 10% and 5%. What is its selling price?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The multiplying factors for successive discounts of 10% and 5% are 9/10 and 19/20 respectively.

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × Discount Multipliers

SP = 18000 × (9/10) × (19/20)

SP = 18000 × (171/200) = 90 × 171 = 15390

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 15,390.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = Rs. 18,000

First successive discount (D₁) = 10%

Second successive discount (D₂) = 5%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − D₁/100) × (1 − D₂/100)
